claims_under_stress.claim_text: QA-dominant aggregation remains a valid and distinct operational family under richer mixed-evidence triage coverage.
Same-family optional/review cases remain closer to safe-like review states than collapse-like or contamination-like states.
The triage middle is structured enough to distinguish review-worthy cases from clearly low-value cases.
Within mixed-evidence triage, structural nuance may help differentiate review-worthy cases, but exact thresholds remain guarded.

open_question: Is the triage soft middle genuinely structured under middle-weighted stress, or only under cleaner panel composition?
